steps.label: Resolve PDF path and hash from file store

operations.label: Resolve PDF path
operations.summary: If pdfPath present use it directly; else open controlDb and call getRegisteredFile(db, pdfFileId) to get storagePath; throws if neither pdfPath nor pdfFileId is available

operations.label: Derive PDF sha256 hash
operations.summary: pdfHash = input.pdfHash ?? registered.sha256 ?? hashFile(storagePath).sha256; fail-safe — warns and returns undefined on error

steps.label: Wait for operator OCR approval and learn signer itemIds (full mode only)
steps.note: Skipped when mode!='full' or signerItemIds already present in input (legacy approve fan-out). Waits cross-process via JSONL backstop. OcrDiscardedError → CancelledError (orange Cancelled row, not red Failed). OcrApprovalFailedError → throw. Zero signer rows after approval → stamp approval-empty + throw (do NOT file an empty ticket).

operations.label: Gate: skip if not full mode or signerItemIds already set
operations.summary: needsApprovalWait = mode==='full' && signerItemIds.length===0; if false → ctx.skipStep('wait-approval')

operations.label: Subscribe to OCR approval signal (cross-process wait)
operations.summary: subscribeToApproval({ workflow: 'ocr', sessionId }, { signal }) — blocks until operator approves or discards the OCR prep in the OCR review panel

operations.label: Extract signer itemIds from approved OCR payload
operations.summary: signerItemIds = [...payload.fannedOutItemIds]; payload.fannedOutItemIds is stamped by the OCR approve route's fan-out

operations.label: Discard → CancelledError (not workflow failure)
operations.summary: OcrDiscardedError → throw Object.assign(new CancelledError('discarded'), { cause: err }) so the terminal row classifies on the Cancel surface

operations.label: OCR prep failure → throw, no ticket filed
operations.summary: OcrApprovalFailedError → throw Error('oath-upload: OCR prep failed — NOT filing the HR ticket')

operations.label: Assert at least one signer row after full-mode approval
operations.summary: If needsApprovalWait && signerItemIds.length===0 → ctx.updateData({status:'approval-empty', signerCount:'0'}), throw — full mode always requires verified signers before filing

steps.label: Wait for all oath-signature signer rows to complete successfully
steps.note: Cross-daemon watch on the oath-signature daemon (not oath-upload's own daemon), eliminating the old single-worker deadlock. Skipped for upload-only or signerItemIds=[]. All signers must be status='done'; any missing/failed/cancelled → throw, no ticket.

operations.label: Gate: skip if upload-only or no signer itemIds
operations.summary: mode==='upload-only' OR signerItemIds.length===0 → ctx.skipStep('wait-signatures'), ctx.updateData({signerCount:'skipped'})

operations.label: Watch oath-signature signer rows until all have terminal outcomes
operations.summary: watchChildRuns({ workflow: 'oath-signature', expectedItemIds: signerItemIds }) — polls tracker JSONL files for terminal outcomes across daemon boundary

operations.label: Assert every expected signer outcome is 'done'
operations.summary: Builds byItem map; any expectedItemId missing or status!='done' → throw with itemId=status list; no HR ticket is filed

steps.label: Probe for prior filed ticket (Contract-2 retry guard)
steps.note: Keyed on sessionId + pdfHash (not runId). A Contract-2 retry assigns a new runId but the same sessionId, so a runId-keyed lookup would miss a prior ticket. Probe is fail-safe: any miss lets the workflow continue.

operations.label: Query tracker for prior HRC ticket matching sessionId/pdfHash
operations.summary: findPriorTicketForSession(sessionId, pdfHash, trackerDir) — controlDb item index + JSONL lookback (7 days); returns HRC ticket string or null

operations.label: Short-circuit: stamp prior ticket and skip ServiceNow steps
operations.summary: If priorTicket: ctx.updateData({ticketNumber: priorTicket}), ctx.skipStep for servicenow-auth + open-hr-form + fill-form + submit, return

steps.label: Authenticate to ServiceNow via UCSD SSO + Duo MFA
steps.note: Auth is deliberately deferred past the signature wait to avoid holding a SAML session open across multi-day signing ceremonies. loginToServiceNow navigates to the HR form URL, skips SSO if already authenticated (subject input visible), otherwise fills SSO credentials and waits for Duo. 300s Duo timeout. Hands-off WebAuthn if HR_AUTOMATION_DUO_WEBAUTHN=1.

operations.label: Navigate to HR Inquiry form for auth probe
operations.summary: page.goto(HR_INQUIRY_FORM_URL, {waitUntil:'domcontentloaded', timeout:15000})

operations.label: Check already authenticated (subject input visible)
operations.summary: hrInquiry.subjectInput(page).isVisible({timeout:2000}) → if true, skip SSO flow and return true

operations.label: Wait for TritON SSO form to render
operations.summary: waitForSsoForm(page, 15000) — polls for a5.ucsd.edu SSO form; needed because ServiceNow auth_redirect.do hop is client-side and form lags ~1-2s

operations.label: Fill SSO username and password
operations.summary: fillSsoCredentials — 3-level fallback selectors (accessible label → alternate label → input[name])

operations.label: Click SSO Log In button
operations.summary: clickSsoSubmit — button[name='_eventId_proceed']

operations.label: Wait for Duo MFA approval
operations.summary: pollDuoApproval / requestDuoApproval — 300s timeout; successUrlMatch=support.ucsd.edu without duosecurity; successCheck=subjectInput visible; hands-off WebAuthn (Touch ID, internal) if HR_AUTOMATION_DUO_WEBAUTHN=1

operations.label: Post-Duo landing verification: HR form subject input visible
operations.summary: hrInquiry.subjectInput(page).isVisible({timeout:5000}) — confirms we landed on the HR Inquiry form, not another ServiceNow redirect target; logs warn + returns false on failure

steps.label: Navigate to HR General Inquiry form and verify

operations.label: Navigate to HR Inquiry catalog item
operations.summary: gotoHrInquiryForm — page.goto with waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'; skips networkidle to avoid 5–10s dead wait on ServiceNow's background XHR

operations.label: Verify title includes 'HR General Inquiry'
operations.summary: verifyOnInquiryForm — page.title() must include 'HR General Inquiry'; throws with current title + URL on mismatch (indicates SSO redirect / session expired)

steps.label: Fill HR Inquiry form fields and attach oath PDF
steps.note: Subject + Description are plain safeFill. 'Specifically' and 'Category' are Select2 v3 typeaheads: click choice anchor → type into search box → click result (or Enter fallback). Category tries native selectOption first, falls back to Select2. File input uses setInputFiles on hidden input to bypass OS file picker.

operations.label: Fill Subject field
Fill Description field
operations.literalValue: Please see attached oaths for employees hired under HDH.

operations.label: Open Specifically Select2 dropdown
operations.summary: Click visible a.select2-choice anchor (accessible combobox is offscreen and times out on direct click)

operations.label: Type into Specifically search box
operations.summary: select2DropSearch(page, 'Specifically') — scoped by search input accessible name ('Select Specifically:') to avoid strict-mode collision with other open drops

operations.label: Wait 800ms for Specifically dropdown results to render
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(800) — Select2 result list loads asynchronously

operations.label: Click Specifically result option
operations.summary: select2ResultOption(page, 'Specifically', value) with 3s timeout; fallback: page.keyboard.press('Enter') to accept highlighted match

operations.label: Select Category via native selectOption (primary path)
operations.summary: categoryInput.selectOption({label: 'Payroll'}, {timeout:3000}); throws → falls back to Select2 combobox path

operations.label: Open Category Select2 dropdown (fallback path)
operations.summary: Fallback when native selectOption throws — click categoryChoice to open Select2 drop
operations.note: Fallback path only; executes when selectOption on categoryInput fails

operations.label: Type into Category search box (fallback path)
operations.summary: select2DropSearch(page, 'Category') — scoped by 'Select Category:' accessible name; page.waitForTimeout(500) after fill

operations.label: Click Category result option (fallback path)
operations.summary: select2ResultOption(page, 'Category', value) with 3s timeout; fallback: Enter

operations.label: Attach oath PDF via hidden file input
operations.summary: hrInquiry.fileInput(page).setInputFiles(attachmentPath) — bypasses the visible 'Choose a file' button to avoid OS file picker

operations.label: Wait 1000ms for file upload to register
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(1000) — upload latency before submit

steps.label: Submit HR Inquiry form and capture ticket number
steps.note: dryRun=true skips the submit click and stamps 'DRY RUN - not submitted'. Ticket number is parsed from the ServiceNow redirect URL (?id=ticket&number=HRC0XXXXXX). Idempotency: a retry that reaches this step with a new runId will have been short-circuited by the idempotency-check step if the prior run filed successfully.

operations.label: Dry-run gate: skip submit if dryRun=true
operations.summary: dryRun → screenshot hr-inquiry-dry-run-pre-submit, ctx.updateData({ticketNumber:'DRY RUN - not submitted', status:'dry-run-complete'}), return early

operations.label: Click Submit button
Wait for post-submit redirect to ticket detail URL
operations.summary: page.waitForURL(url => url !== before && url.includes('number='), {timeout:60000}); falls through on stale event — URL is probed directly after

operations.label: Parse ticket number from redirect URL
operations.summary: parseTicketNumberFromUrl(page.url()) — extracts ?number=HRC0XXXXXX via URL.searchParams; validates /^HRC\d{6,}$/

operations.label: Assert ticket number was captured from redirect URL
operations.summary: Throws submitAndCaptureTicketNumber: no number= param in post-submit URL if num is null

notes: Mode gate: mode='full' && signerItemIds absent → wait-approval (cross-process OCR subscribe) → wait-signatures (cross-daemon watchChildRuns) → ServiceNow ticket. mode='upload-only' → skip both waits, file ticket directly. Legacy rows with signerItemIds already set skip only wait-approval.

Born-at-upload (option A): the ticket row is enqueued at /api/ocr/prepare before OCR review; the OCR prep run is delegated under it (parentRunId=oathUploadRunId). This row IS the ticket — no second row is created at approve time for operationWorkflow='oath-upload'.

Cross-daemon fan-out: oath-upload WAITS on oath-signature rows (watchChildRuns), it does NOT delegate to them. Signer rows are fanned out by the OCR approve route independently, eliminating the single-worker deadlock of the old delegate-signatures step.
Dry-run boundary: dryRun=true skips only the ServiceNow submit click in the submit step; all preceding steps (including signature wait and form fill) execute normally.

Cancel is TREE-scoped (E2E-010): cancelling the ticket row also cancels the delegated OCR prep and its descendants (lookup rows) via resolveActionTargets tree walk. Row-scope cancel left the OCR review orphaned at awaiting-approval.
Zero signer guard: full mode with zero fanned-out signer rows after OCR approval → stamp status=approval-empty, signerCount=0, throw — never file an empty ticket.
Idempotency probe (between wait-signatures and servicenow-auth): keyed on sessionId+pdfHash (not runId) so Contract-2 retries with a new runId still find and reuse the prior HRC ticket number.
ServiceNow auth is deliberately deferred past all waits to avoid holding a SAML session open across multi-day signing ceremonies.
